data.narrative:
Skyeton operates in the Defense & Security sector at the Growth stage. The valuation universe comprises 10 identified comparables: 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers, including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Saronic, and Quantum-Systems. The broader Defense & Security sector contains 21 same-sector peers, though narrower stage and tier-based filtering yielded insufficient datapoints for reliable peer-median analysis.

The Peer-Median approach, the primary triangulation method for Growth-stage companies, is not applicable here. The Defense & Security sector lacks sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables meeting minimum thresholds (need ≥3; found 0 in each category). Relying on all-sector medians would introduce unacceptable noise given the specialized nature of defense technology and customer bases. The small and fragmented comparable set—driven by the sector's limited public float and sparse disclosure among private defense firms—prevents robust statistical triangulation across standard multiples.

Without sufficient comp density to support peer-median valuation, additional methods (precedent transactions, DCF anchored to disclosed metrics, or revenue/EBITDA multiples) would be required to establish a defensible range. The primary uncertainty is structural: Defense & Security lacks the comparable depth typical of venture-backed sectors. Any valuation should acknowledge that triangulation reliability is constrained by data availability rather than company-specific risk factors.
